seasons.title: Delivery Boys
seasons.arc_summary: The party forms in Hallia, takes mercenary courier work, uncovers Oogathal infiltrators posing as Blackline cops, and traces a radar-dish conspiracy to the Embercall company and the Roundhat Gang. The arc culminates in a catastrophic ambush at the Crowded Flea that leaves three party members dead.

seasons.title: The Black and White
seasons.arc_summary: In the aftermath of the TPK, Johnny and Benny traverse the afterlife, meet the entity Aut, and return to life — joined by Sir Arctos, a sentient polar bear paladin. The party exacts vengeance on Hlarf and Tywelwyn Leatherhide, uncovering a plot by six alien gods attempting to crack the firmament via a network of radar dishes.

seasons.title: The Pilgrimage
seasons.arc_summary: Rescuing Anaïs reveals the existence of the Narrative — five cosmic siblings governing fate. The party attends a mysterious pilgrimage gathering at Ragged Roost, surviving a gladiatorial trial and a scavenger hunt to learn the location of a keystone, then acquires it through art trading, diplomacy, and a deadly ambush by Concordia agents.

seasons.title: Cracks in the Firmament
seasons.arc_summary: Argyle returns in half-altered form as the party enters months of downtime, then descends into Hallia's sewers to investigate Teller's Run — discovering a fracture in reality, an imprisoned giant god behind the firmament, and a conspiracy to shatter the barrier. The party bombs the research facility, collapsing the district and triggering a mushroom cloud of ash.

seasons.title: The Strider
seasons.arc_summary: The party departs Hallia aboard a colossal arachnid Strider city, builds alliances with rival factions, survives a deadly weekly tithe of heart-energy, explores the Undercroft to ally with an ancient Machine God, and accidentally destroys a member of the cosmic Narrative — stranding them on a dead, scoured world far beyond the known map.

seasons.title: Season 1
seasons.arc_summary: In the first session of a new Færrin-set one-shot (now a two-shot), four members of the Velvet Mark — Archie, Salvatore, Branson, and Combo — are tasked by Father Marone to assassinate the Spark, leader of the upstart gang Pyrelight. En route to Teller's Run, they're pulled over by Threshold Authority officers, leading to a violent car chase that ends with the cops' car flipped and destroyed. After ditching their identifiable car at Feathers' shop for a disguise, they sneak into Teller's Run and discover the Spark presiding over a burning-stage spectacle with a cheering crowd.

shows.name: A Hunt of Metal and Vine

seasons.title: Terror and Descent
seasons.arc_summary: Noah's Cagley Middle one-shot concludes as four 8th-grade heroes slay the shadow demon Terror of Cagley, then Josh's Scale one-shot opens as four operatives arrive on a shattered Joker World and battle swarming demon spawn in a rain-soaked chasm.

seasons.title: The Quorum and the Voice of Many
seasons.arc_summary: The Scale operatives infiltrate the Quorum — a fiend installation atop a bloodfall portal — solving monolith puzzles, battling Sigzilheight's forces, and ultimately rescuing Voice of Many, a trapped divine heart and grandchild of the Judge, before teleporting back to headquarters.

seasons.title: The Verdant Expanse
seasons.arc_summary: Three Iridescent Church convox detectives travel to the logging town of Wrenford to investigate husk-murders linked to a vanished commune member. Following a Feyrock necklace into the mile-tall Verdant Expanse, they survive the forest's dangers, rescue a lost boy, and destroy a fey court — only to learn their prime suspect is already dead and the huskification curse continues unabated.

seasons.title: The Gloaming Codex
seasons.arc_summary: The Convox pivots from the forest to the city, tracing fey stone to a jeweler's conference and a mysterious suspect's apartment. There they discover the Gloaming Codex — a ritual book that transmutes bodies into fey stone — and are pulled inside its pages, forced to fight for their lives against carnivorous ink and cursed thoughts.

seasons.title: Season 1
seasons.arc_summary: In a one-shot set months before the main campaign, three Undercroft workers — Barlow Crane, Grant FireEye, and Gage the Cunning — investigate sabotage aboard the massive moving Strider city of Iomenei. Tracking an elven suspect named Gerhardt into a long-abandoned forsaken sector, they discover an insectoid infestation centered on a dormant engine heart cathedral and must slay a massive Swarm Hive Mother. Though they halt the infestation, the true saboteur remains at large.

seasons.title: The Everdawn Drift
seasons.arc_summary: Three Sedecium agents investigate an unpowered orbital station partially sunk into the slip, uncovering evidence that the Thessian Esoterica (formerly Gremory) tortured the station's AI and accessed ancient observatory records of a massive magical spike near the Astra's core.

seasons.title: One Last Job: Stealing from a Dead God
seasons.arc_summary: Pulled from retirement for a single high-stakes raid, the fire team descends through the Slip to the surface of a freshly-killed Thessian god to steal its divine essence before the God Eater Harrow finishes devouring it, becoming the first and only team to succeed.

seasons.title: Season 1
seasons.arc_summary: A D&D 5e one-shot set on the Finnegan Ring caravan route. Three caravan members — Mango the elven ranger, Doug Donahue the gnome rogue, and Egan the orc druid — are transported along with flautist Erin Proudcloak to a fey swampland by a mysterious mist. There, the fey creature Larunan forces them to fight for his amusement in an arena battle full of chaotic magical effects. The party survives and is returned to the caravan.
